skills.name: ctf-forensics
skills.description: Digital forensics techniques for CTF challenges. Covers PCAP analysis, steganography, file carving, metadata extraction, log analysis, and hidden data discovery in files.

skills.name: ctf-reverse
skills.description: Reverse engineering techniques for CTF challenges. Covers ELF binary analysis, string extraction, disassembly, Java reverse engineering, and deobfuscation of compiled code.

skills.name: ctf-web
skills.description: Web exploitation techniques for CTF challenges. Covers SQL injection, XSS, SSRF, path traversal, JWT attacks, authentication bypass, and common web vulnerability patterns seen in CTF competitions.

skills.name: solve-challenge
skills.description: Master orchestrator for solving CTF challenges. Analyses challenge files, determines the category, routes to the appropriate category skill, and guides the agent through discovery, exploitation, and flag capture.
